q: The Zimmer conjecture for SL(n,ℝ)-lattices Γ says that any volume-preserving C∞ action of Γ on a compact manifold M must satisfy:
exp: Zimmer: if Γ≤SL(n,ℝ) is a lattice (e.g., SL(n,ℤ)), any faithful volume-preserving smooth action on compact M has dim(M)≥n-1 (the real rank). Smaller-dimensional M can only be acted on trivially (action factors through a finite group).
